execution.description: The research surface over the synthetic demo campaign: Launchpad, the active campaign and every tab, a note posted through the page, and the rail at phone width.

expected: Every view fits without a horizontal page scroll at 390 px. The charts read at both widths. A note with markup shows as text.
observed: No horizontal page scroll on any view at 390 px; only the tab strip and wide tables scroll inside themselves. The rail collapses behind Menu, and the dark theme and the inverted wordmark hold. A posted note containing an img tag rendered as text, with no element created. Six layout faults, all fixed: tile hints ran into one line; the back link carried the link arrow; a 640-unit chart viewBox shrank its text to about 5 px in a half-width panel (now 480); direct labels collided where reference and prediction converge, and ran off the edge (now plain series only, spread apart); bar legend swatches did not match the bars; and the six setup cards wrapped five and one. The palette check passes CVD separation (37.4) and contrast, and fails the categorical lightness and chroma bands by design: ink, one red and a dashed gray, with dashes as the secondary encoding. A click by coordinate under a scaled viewport emulation landed on the theme toggle, not the note field.
